caption: The result row is the composite pixel: each channel takes 0.2 of the blue top layer and 0.8 of the background. That 0.2 is layer opacity 0.5 times the mask value 0.4, so blue rises from 50 to 91 while red falls from 200 to 160.

spec.title: Mask 0.4 × opacity 0.5
spec.aria: A three-column table for channels R, G and B. The background pixel is 200, 100, 50; the blue top layer is 0, 0, 255; the effective alpha is 0.2 in every channel; the composite result is 160, 80, 91.
